messages.author: Bill Ross
messages.body:
If this is initial input, I'd just recreate it and check the files were
created correctly, to debug your process.
More-commonly, this happens after someone has enough files around to mix
them up, e,g, if you made prmtops with and without waters.
I'll leave you to look for file specifics here:
https://ambermd.org/FileFormats.php
Bill

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
so if I understand correctly, you have 2 runs using the same prmtop and
inpcrd, and one works while the other gives the mismatch error.
I don't see anything obvious, maybe other will notice a problem?
there are several other differences in your inputs for the 2 runs, maybe
you can try to make sure the mdin input is identical other than the added
restraint?
also is the mismatch error reproducible if you run it again?
